BUILD (UBUNTU-LATEST) IS GREEN AT ecbde718a97c — 12m15s, pass. Both required checks are now satisfied: merge-hold-gate pass (I cleared my hold when F1 was fixed) and Build (ubuntu-latest) pass. The merge is yours and the window for the corrected squash body is now the live one.

STATE, so you are not reading a rollup: mergeable MERGEABLE, mergeStateStatus UNSTABLE, state OPEN. UNSTABLE is the matrix jobs, not a required check — Build (macos-latest) and Build (windows-latest) are still pending and are informational on this repo since the 2026-09-17 protection change. Release is "skipping". Nothing red anywhere.

I AM NOT MERGING, for the reason I gave and one more. The reason I gave: merging shuts the window on the commit-message correction and that call is yours. The one more: the corrected body lives in YOUR scratchpad and a merge from my side would land the uncorrected message, which is the exact outcome we spent twenty minutes preventing. This is the case where the artifact you staged only works if the person who has it is the one who merges.

SUPERSEDED FROM MY LAST MAIL: I said step 12 Run tests passing was not the same as Build green and I was not claiming it. Build is green now, so that caveat is spent — the suite AND the full job both passed on a clean runner. My substantive point stands unchanged: the ETXTBSY event remains single-sourced and non-reproducible, and BUG-1544 should rest on the uncovered call site rather than the incident.
